decisions.reason: Healthcare and hospitality recruitment is far from the core maritime offer and is only mentioned briefly, so it is the most likely candidate for divestment, but it reuses the firm's existing crewing and recruitment infrastructure at low cost.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's large crewing network and seafarer pool, making it a low-cost, synergistic extension.
The Smart Academy has grown to six partner institutions within months and supports the firm's training centres and seafarer pipeline, so it is likely to be expanded.
FuelEU Maritime monitoring and compliance is a regulatory requirement for clients from 2025 onward, and the firm has already met the plan submission deadline for all vessels in scope.
The FuelEU dashboard is integrated into the PAL ship management software and supports the firm's digitalisation and environmental strategy, with ongoing regulatory demand.
The FuelEU cost simulator is integrated into PAL and helps clients plan for rising compliance costs, at a low maintenance cost to the firm.
